'''CryonCorp''' was a manufacturer of personal scanning devices during the last few [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. One of their products was the [[EnhanceScan general purpose scanner/Legends|EnhanceScan general-purpose scanner]].<ref name="EGWT" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], CryonCorp supported the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and allied itself with [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], supplying the Rebellion with technology. CryonCorp remained the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] foremost supplier of scanning devices and sensor equipment.
